title: product.toml - brickie v0.1 product selection surface (BRV-D2: single-record shape)
description: Expresses single-record shape only (contract §7.2). Cross-field/cross-file invariants ('exactly one app', root type vs plugin type, budget vs closure) are reported as codes by brickie-core. ADR-0035: every root is a record { brick, requires } in [product]; app/platform/core are singletons and [[product.ability]] is the list.

ability.description: `[[product.ability]]`: one array element per block, each `<alias> = { brick = ..., requires = ... }`. The alias is a label only -- the plugin identity is always `brick`.

kernel.description: Tick frequency (like Linux CONFIG_HZ): timer interrupts per second. Absent table / omitted hz = default 200 (one tick per 5 ms). brickie build turns the value into -DBR_CFG_TICK_HZ for all translation units (ADR-0017).

hz.description: Timer interrupts per second (Hz). Common values 100/200/250/1000; the upper bound is enforced by a _Static_assert in br_time.h.

selftest_sources.description: Default selftest sources for the **core** plugin (ADR-0010), relative to the repo root: pre-ADR-0039 home of the core suite. A plugin's own suite now lives in its `[build].selftest_sources` (plugin-relative); this product-level key remains the core default for compatibility.

selftest.description: ADR-0010: global selftest switch + optional plugin list. Absent table = follow [product].stage (dev on / release off).

enabled.description: true/false explicit; the string "inherit" = follow stage (same as the default).

plugins.description: Run only the listed plugins; an empty array = every plugin that declares [selftest].

selection.description: One selection record (ADR-0035): `brick` names the plugin, `requires` carries that same brick's version requirement only.

version.description: Version range (3 segments, compared against the brick's MAJOR.MINOR.REVISE).
